cards.title: Flashcards in Gemini Notebook get images and reminders
cards.what: Flashcards made from your sources now include images, a stopwatch, and mobile reminders to review.
cards.try_for: Turn a new safety or product training document into flashcards and send staff a review reminder.
cards.why: Useful for exam study, but most staff training does not need timed recall drills.
cards.catch: Reminders work only in the Gemini Notebook mobile app.
cards.data_caution: Do not upload internal training files to a personal Google account.
cards.original_title: New study enhancements for Flashcards in Gemini Notebook

cards.title: Clay sales data tool inside ChatGPT and Codex
cards.what: Connects Clay's sales research data to ChatGPT and Codex so users can research deals and build sales plays.
cards.try_for: Ask ChatGPT, using Clay's connection, to summarise a target account before your next visit.
cards.why: The text is a customer story and does not say how to get access, what it costs, or whether ordinary users can use it yet.
cards.catch: The text gives no setup steps, pricing or availability, and it does not show how accurate the results are.
cards.data_caution: Do not paste customer contact details, pricing terms or unreleased deal information into any outside tool without checking company data rules first.
cards.original_title: Clay helps sales teams win with Codex and ChatGPT

cards.title: Google Search that uses your own Drive and Wallet
cards.what: Lets you opt in to connect Google Wallet, Drive and the Gemini app so AI Mode answers in Search can use your personal information.
cards.try_for: Opt in, then ask AI Mode to summarise your visit notes for a bar account before your next call.
cards.why: The announcement does not say who can use it or where, so it is not clear it is available to staff yet.
cards.catch: Connecting personal accounts means Search answers draw on your files, and the text gives no detail on how this is limited.
cards.data_caution: Do not connect accounts or Drive folders holding confidential pricing, contracts or customer data without IT or legal approval.
cards.original_title: A more tailored Google Search that’s uniquely yours

cards.title: Google Vids keeps your media for reuse in AI videos
cards.what: Images, videos and audio you use in Vids AI video generation are saved in an Assets section to reuse in the same project.
cards.try_for: Build a short internal launch video in Vids, then reuse the same logo and clips for a second cut.
cards.why: It is on by default for Vids users and saves re-uploading the same media.
cards.catch: Assets are reused only within the same project, not across projects.
cards.data_caution: Keep unreleased campaign visuals out unless your Workspace account is approved for them.
cards.original_title: Google Vids now lets you reuse your media in video generation

cards.title: Gemini Notebook turns your sources into interactive sites
cards.what: Type "make me a site" in Gemini Notebook to turn your sources into a shareable interactive page, such as a dashboard or tracker.
cards.try_for: Upload last quarter's sales summary and ask for an interactive dashboard to share with the team.
cards.why: It is available globally on the web, and summarising data for others is a common task.
cards.catch: Check every figure on the generated site against the source file.
cards.data_caution: Do not upload confidential sales or financial data to a personal account.
cards.original_title: Transform your notes and research into dynamic tools with Gemini Notebook

cards.title: Gemini app now runs on lower-memory Android phones
cards.what: The Gemini app now works on older or lower-memory Android phones, including Gemini Live and custom image creation.
cards.try_for: Create a rough image concept for a social post idea on your Android phone using the Gemini app's custom image feature.
cards.why: The text says the app is available today on these phones, and image concepts are a task marketing staff already do.
cards.catch: The announcement does not say which phone models qualify or whether any features cost extra, so check your device first.
cards.data_caution: Do not enter unreleased product names, recipes, pricing, or consumer research data into the app.
cards.original_title: The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices.

cards.title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models in ChatGPT
cards.what: New OpenAI models with better professional outputs and computer use, available in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API.
cards.try_for: Rerun a report or brief you wrote last month in ChatGPT Work and compare the two drafts.
cards.why: The announcement is a short summary, so how much better it is for everyday work is unclear.
cards.catch: A model upgrade can change outputs from prompts that used to work.

cards.title: Tasks in Gemini, now free in six countries
cards.what: Gemini can carry out tasks on your behalf, with deeper Google Workspace integration; free in six countries.
cards.try_for: Ask Gemini to collect this week's customer follow-ups from Gmail into one task list.
cards.why: New features start in the U.S., and the text does not say which six countries are free.
cards.catch: Availability outside the U.S. is unclear.
cards.data_caution: Check what Gmail and Drive access you give it before connecting a work account.
cards.original_title: Put Gemini to work for you

cards.title: ChatGPT for Sales plugin
cards.what: A Sales plugin plus 30+ partner plugins in ChatGPT to research prospects, prepare pitches and update your CRM.
cards.try_for: Before a bar or retailer visit, ask it to research the outlet and draft three talking points.
cards.why: Visit prep and CRM updates are core sales tasks, and it lives in ChatGPT, which many staff already use.
cards.catch: CRM updates depend on which partner plugins your company has connected.
cards.data_caution: Do not paste customer pricing or contract terms unless ChatGPT is your company's approved tool.

cards.title: Share Gemini skills and add Drive files to them
cards.what: Gemini skills, which are reusable custom instructions, can now be shared with colleagues and include files from Drive, Gemini Notebook and Photos.
cards.try_for: Make a skill holding your tone-of-voice guide and share it with the comms team.
cards.why: It is a small addition, but sharing one set of instructions keeps a team's outputs consistent.
cards.catch: Anyone with Edit permission can change the shared skill for everyone.
cards.data_caution: Files added to a skill are shared with everyone you share the skill with.
cards.original_title: Share skills and add files from Google Drive, Gemini Notebook and Google Photos to your skills in the Gemini app

cards.title: Google Pics upgrades to Nano Banana 2.1
cards.what: Google Pics image generation and editing now use Nano Banana 2.1, with better detail, more precise edits and cleaner text.
cards.try_for: Generate three social post visuals with a short headline in the image and compare the text quality.
cards.why: Cleaner text in images helps social and event visuals, and the upgrade applies to existing features.
cards.catch: Generated visuals still need a brand and legal check before use.
cards.data_caution: Do not upload unreleased product packaging or campaign artwork.
cards.original_title: Google Pics upgrades to Nano Banana 2.1 for higher-quality image generation and editing

cards.title: Gemini writes Apps Script for you in Sheets and Docs
cards.what: A Gemini side panel in Apps Script writes and fixes automation scripts from a plain-language description.
cards.try_for: Describe a weekly report you build by hand in Sheets and ask Gemini to write a script that builds it.
cards.why: It is generally available, and many finance and planning tasks are repetitive spreadsheet work.
cards.catch: A script that runs on its own can change or delete data; test it on a copy first.
cards.data_caution: Check your company's policy on running scripts against shared finance files.
cards.original_title: Easily customize and extend Google Workspace with Gemini in Apps Script

cards.title: Tabletop: shared planning spaces from Google Labs
cards.what: A Google Labs experiment for groups to build interactive itineraries, polls and brackets together.
cards.try_for: Plan a team offsite agenda with a poll for the activity.
cards.why: It is an experiment with a waitlist, so it is not ready for regular use.
cards.catch: Labs experiments can change or shut down without notice.
cards.data_caution: Keep employee personal details out of an experimental product.
cards.original_title: Try Tabletop: Customizable, collaborative spaces for groups to plan, play and do more together.

cards.title: Adobe tools inside Google Drive and Gemini
cards.what: Google and Adobe are integrating tools so you can edit PDFs in Drive and use Adobe AI in Gemini.
cards.try_for: Edit a supplier PDF directly in Drive instead of downloading it.
cards.why: The text is a short summary and does not say when or for which accounts it is available.
cards.catch: It may need an Adobe subscription; the text does not say.
cards.original_title: We’re bringing Adobe’s creative and productivity tools closer to your everyday Google apps.

cards.title: Businesses in ChatGPT: manage how your brand appears
cards.what: Businesses can manage their information, see how they show up in ChatGPT, and turn that interest into action.
cards.try_for: Ask ChatGPT about your brands and check the answers, then look at what the business page lets you correct.
cards.why: How people find brands through AI matters for marketing, but the text gives little detail.
cards.catch: The text does not say who can claim a business or what it costs.
cards.data_caution: Only brand owners should make changes on behalf of the company.

cards.title: ChatGPT Images 2.6 adds GIFs and precise edits
cards.what: Faster image generation, GIF creation and more precise editing in ChatGPT.
cards.try_for: Make a short GIF for an internal announcement in ChatGPT.
cards.why: It is available in ChatGPT now, and quick visuals are a common comms task.
cards.catch: Generated images still need a brand check before use outside the company.
cards.data_caution: Do not upload unreleased product images.

cards.title: GPT-6 with Intelligent UI in ChatGPT
cards.what: GPT-6 is rolling out globally in ChatGPT, answering with visuals and interactive elements you can use directly.
cards.try_for: Ask ChatGPT to compare two months of sales figures and explore the visual it returns.
cards.why: It is rolling out to everyone in ChatGPT, so staff can use it without new tools.
cards.catch: Visual answers can make wrong numbers look convincing; check the source figures.
cards.data_caution: Do not paste confidential sales data into a personal ChatGPT account.
cards.original_title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone

cards.title: New visual ad format in ChatGPT
cards.what: ChatGPT now offers a visual ad format, plus more measurement, attribution and brand-suitability tools for advertisers.
cards.try_for: Review the new format with your media agency and decide if a small test campaign fits a brand.
cards.why: A new ad channel matters for marketing, but results and costs are not shown yet.
cards.catch: Ads appearing next to AI answers may raise brand-safety questions.
cards.original_title: Building advertising for the way people use AI

cards.title: Dots: proactive assistants from OpenAI
cards.what: Dots are assistants that keep working on projects and everyday tasks, with controls to stay in charge.
cards.try_for: Set up a dot to prepare a short summary before each weekly sales meeting.
cards.why: It could change how routine work is done, but the text says little about cost or availability.
cards.catch: An assistant acting on its own needs clear limits on what it can send or change.
cards.data_caution: Check what accounts and files a dot can reach before connecting work systems.
